settings.title: Settings
settings.copilot_fqdn_helper: CoPilot holds security data: keep it on a private network or a VPN, not on the Internet.
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.access_token_expire_minutes_helper: Users log in again after this time. Default: 1440 (one day).
settings.access_token_expire_minutes_invalid: Enter a whole number between 5 and 525600
settings.audit_log_retention_days_helper: Older audit log entries are deleted every day. 0 keeps them forever. Default: 90.
settings.audit_log_retention_days_invalid: Enter a whole number between 0 and 36500
settings.default_alert_severity_helper: Severity of the alerts whose source gives none, such as Office 365 or CrowdStrike.
settings.announcements_enabled_helper: Show the SOCFortress news feed, downloaded from GitHub.
settings.talon_release_check_enabled_helper: Check ghcr.io for new releases of the Talon AI analyst. Disable it on networks without Internet access.
settings.mail_on_description: CoPilot sends e-mail through the smarthost of the cluster. A smarthost with TLS from the first byte (port 465) does not work: use STARTTLS.
settings.mail_off_description: Configure the smarthost of the cluster to send temporary passwords and customer portal notifications.
settings.mail_from_helper: Sender of the CoPilot e-mails. Empty: the smarthost user name, else noreply at the host name.
